technology_name: Hearing Aid Configuration and Audiology Software (SHRUTHI)
institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Difficulty in tailoring hearing aids to individual hearing profiles
description: SHRUTHI is a software application used for customizing TARANG hearing aids. It includes modules for client management, audiometric analysis, and fitting procedures, enabling audiologists to configure hearing aids according to individual requirements.
applications:
Audiology clinics and hearing care centers
Hospitals, ENT departments, and rehabilitation facilities
Hearing aid manufacturers and assistive technology companies
Special education institutions and hearing rehabilitation programs
Government healthcare agencies and organizations supporting persons with hearing impairments
